payload.summary: Email confirming dental mitigation plan with phased access and mock service path.

decisions.label: grant partial sandbox access
decisions.anchorText: Partial sandbox access for named users begins 4/18.

decisions.label: implement mock-service mitigation
decisions.anchorText: Vendor accepted that we will proceed with a mock-service mitigation path for any capability not available in the partial environment.

decisions.label: update primary blocker status
decisions.anchorText: I recommend: moving the primary blocker from active to partially mitigated,

decisions.label: update PI objective percentages
decisions.anchorText: I recommend: updating PI objective percentages,

decisions.label: use staged path in leadership language
decisions.anchorText: I recommend: using the staged path in all leadership-facing language.

warnings: This does not make Dental healthy, but it materially improves the planning picture compared with where we were on 4/13.
